name: Marching Tetrahedra
definition: Isosurface reconstruction technique that subdivides a cube into 6 tetrahedra to avoid ambiguities present in Marching Cubes. Values between tetrahedron edges are calculated using inverse linear interpolation for the parameter and linear interpolation for 3D coordinates.
summary: Marching Tetrahedra is an isosurface extraction algorithm that decomposes voxels into tetrahedra to resolve topological ambiguities and guarantee manifold meshes without cracks.
